name: tier-sizes
title: Tier sizes fix disclosure
idea: Tier sizes alone set how many pairs a rule states, whatever the estimates (when no two are equal); for a given number of tiers, balanced sizes state the most.
from: new angle · v1 R-01's formula panel and its 1/1/28 counterexample; adds editable tier sizes, the N of every size pattern at one G and the closed form when G divides n
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 9, 16 and 17.
caption: Ordered positive tier-size patterns, each with equal weight; no posterior errors are inferred from disclosure counts. Quantile ties are kept together by the package.
